keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Marcus Thuram (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Nicolò Barella (Inter Milan).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Yann Bisseck (Inter Milan).
Delay in match because of an injury Chris Führich (Stuttgart).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Federico Dimarco replaces Alessandro Bastoni because of an injury.
First Half ends, Inter Milan 0, Stuttgart 0.
Second Half begins Inter Milan 0, Stuttgart 0.
Finn Jeltsch (Stuttgart) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Inter Milan 1, Stuttgart 0. Petar Sucic (Inter Milan) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Jamie Leweling replaces Josha Vagnoman.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Deniz Undav replaces Chris Führich.
Delay in match because of an injury Josep Martínez (Inter Milan).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Lautaro Martínez replaces Marcus Thuram.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Curtis Jones replaces Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Angelo Stiller replaces Nikolas Nartey.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Luca Jaquez replaces Finn Jeltsch.
Goal! Inter Milan 2, Stuttgart 0. Lautaro Martínez (Inter Milan) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Federico Dimarco.
Manuel Akanji (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Tiago Tomás replaces Bilal El Khannouss.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Aleksandar Stankovic replaces Nicolò Barella.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Andy Diouf replaces Francesco Pio Esposito.
Second Half ends, Inter Milan 2, Stuttgart 0.
